Rotate into 005930 (Samsung) and 000660 (SK Hynix) for memory-cycle leverage, but trim NINE and KREN after sharp rallies to lock gains. Maintain normal risk, favor liquid names with earnings catalysts over speculative movers.

themes: Digital lending and fintech penetration in Indonesia is accelerating as bank credit growth outpaces GDP, driven by rising middle-class consumption and regulatory support for alternative credit scoring

US financials face headwinds from delayed Fed cuts and tighter commercial real estate exposure, making Indonesian financials a relative safe-haven for regional capital flows.
sectors.ai: Expect continued selective strength in Indonesian financials, led by digital-lending and fintech names (FUJI, BSWD, COIN) as retail credit demand rebounds and regulatory tailwinds favor formalization. Rotate into high-beta small caps with earnings momentum, but trim exposure to US-listed financials where rate-cut repricing caps upside. Maintain overweight on ID financials, targeting 8-12% alpha over 3 months.

themes: Nickel and gold prices are structurally supported by EV battery demand and central bank buying, providing durable upside for MBMA and BRMS.

Global energy security concerns and OPEC+ supply discipline underpin coal and oil prices, sustaining cash flows for SGER and CF despite ESG headwinds.

Expect continued outperformance in Indonesian miners as global energy transition demand and rupiah tailwinds persist.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesian EV value-chain names (VKTR, TOBA) are compounding on domestic nickel smelting and bus electrification mandates, decoupling from US rate cycles.
Biomass and geothermal operators (NRG, ESSA) benefit from PLN's baseload substitution program, securing long-term PPAs that stabilize cash flows.
US renewable utilities (CEG, BEP) face margin compression from falling power prices and higher financing costs, making them tactical shorts versus ID longs.
sectors.ai: Buy VKTR and TOBA for domestic EV/battery supply-chain momentum, and add NRG for biomass-to-power upside; trim US-exposed CEG/BEP given rate-sensitive headwinds. Rotate into Indonesian names with local offtake and policy tailwinds, targeting 5-8% alpha over 3 months while hedging global clean-energy beta.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Pre-Lebaran consumption front-loading is a durable 6-week catalyst for FMCG and staples, compressing inventory cycles and lifting small-cap distributors disproportionately.
Rupiah stability versus the dollar is structurally improving domestic purchasing power, favoring local-brand consumer names over import-heavy or US-exposed FMCG operators.
The IDX consumer segment is rotating into mid/small caps (BRRC, COIN, JARR) as institutional flows chase higher beta, a pattern that persists while aggregate sector gains stay positive.
sectors.ai: Indonesia consumer/FMCG is in a selective upcycle: domestic names are ripping on rupiah stability and pre-Lebaran restocking, while US-linked exposure drags. Buy the local-demand winners (BRRC, COIN, JARR, BWPT) on momentum, but cap position sizes—this is a WATCH signal, not a broad re-rate. Fade any US-tied laggards until the IDX consumer breadth confirms a second week of gains.
